annotations.title: Get a store's discount codes and deals

description: Every live discount code and deal Vouchernaut lists for one UK store, in the order its store page shows them: the code itself, what it saves, its terms and end date, how many shoppers said it worked or failed, and a link that opens the store with the offer. The store can be named ("Arena Flowers"), or given by its slug or its vouchernaut.com page. Each link may earn Vouchernaut a commission, which every result discloses.

kind.description: Only codes, only deals, or both

store.description: The store's name, slug or vouchernaut.com store page URL
